## Milestone 1: Initial Demo (Scenes/Interactions)

[https://github.com/orgs/p3d-project/projects/1/views/1?filterQuery=milestone%3A%22Milestone+%231%22](https://github.com/orgs/p3d-project/projects/1/views/1?filterQuery=milestone%3A%22Milestone+%231%22)  
The aim is to implement basic initial engine support/systems, workflow, and documentation for the game, and create a promotional video to try to recruit other volunteers to help out\!  
LOCKED TOPICS: 

* FEMC support

### 3D & environment

* Fix Iwatodai Dorm, Iwatodai Streets, Paulownia Mall

  * *Fixed camera views*  
  * Correct player positioning & size  
  * Mapping  
* *Finish Paulownia Mall*  
* Add Makoto model  
* Optimize Makoto/Kotone models  
  * Use correct animations  
  * Reduce poly count majorly (ensure that textures/animations still remain correctly mapped)  
  * Have setting to switch between Makoto/Kotone models  
* Create the initial intro sequence (where Makoto moves into the dorm)  
  * Add scripting up to move-in, and add Gekkoukan section if the 3D environment model is ready

### UI

* Create UI for world (can be static/placeholder for now)  
  * The calendar/dates in the top-right corner (sub-screen?)  
* Create basic console UI for battle system  
  * Similar to PauseMenu, MainMenu. Using BaseMenu  
* Create UI for dialogue  
  * Standard/FEMC versions

### Misc.

## Milestone 2: Graphical Polish \+ Graphical Systems

[https://github.com/orgs/p3d-project/projects/1/views/1?filterQuery=milestone%3A%22Milestone+%232%22](https://github.com/orgs/p3d-project/projects/1/views/1?filterQuery=milestone%3A%22Milestone+%232%22)   
The aim is to add graphics to pre-existing systems (polishing them up) to really make the game feel “authentic”, and add additional graphics systems support & optimizations to the game engine.  
LOCKED TOPICS:

* Tartarus entrance 3D model

### 3D & Environment

* Add billboarded NPCs (sprite work)  
* Add “World Map” view (graphics)  
  * Tap/select between locations on the sub screen?  
  * See details on the top screen?  
* Add Tartarus entrance environment model (3D modellers)

### UI

* Create UI for main menu  
* Create basic UI for pause menu  
  * Just one layer deep is okay for now  
  * Create character sprites for top-screen  
  * Implement in code  
* Create Button Prompts & Iconography  
  * A UI for pop-up notifications/indicators  
* Update the SignContract UI

### Engine

* Revamp 3D support  
  * Add vertex shadow/lighting support  
  * Fix z-fighting  
* Revamp collision system  
  * Needs to support 3D space  
  * Update web tool to support 3D space  
  * Add support for stairs (so the character changes height when interacting with them)  
* Create additional graphics/UI support  
  * Create animation support (one-time and repeating animations)  
  * Create/update graphics documentation, standards, tutorials  
  * Create custom text engine  
  * Create web tool to allow art/dev team to create & export UIScreen code  
* Remove bad graphics rendering support from dialogue, menu systems & replace with UIController/UIScreen system  
* Revamp controllers to use singleton pattern  
* Create proper DB solution  
  * Unify databases w/parent-child relation  
  * XML auto-generated DBs?  
  * Move DBs into /data folder  
* Optimize VRAM usage  
  * Use limited background/sprite colour palettes for 2D  
  * Dynamically stream, load in/out environment textures based on character position  
  * Optimize textures on 3D models  
* Create CameraController  
  * Better camera support  
* ~~Create a universal “EnvironmentView” that other views inherit?~~

### Website

* Create website homepage  
* Create website page for UIScreen generation tool  
  * Upload assets, move them around, import animations, and then export as importable code  
* Create docs pages

## Next Milestones (Rough)

* Create basic Tartarus level generator system (environment)  
  * Dynamically creates levels  
* Create basic Persona compendium system (view personas, NOT fusion)  
  * We want this for initial Velvet room support  
* Sub-screen minimap in Tartarus (graphics)  
* Tartarus level select graphics (graphics)  
* Battle system UI (graphics)  
* In-game event scripting system (i.e. in-game cutscenes)  
  * Will require separate CameraController (to move camera separately)  
  * Will require path finding/mapping  
* NPC pathfinding support (characters in world, enemies in Tartarus)  
* 3D battle system (Example: Pokemon Emerald for the GBA)

* Optimize JSON animations (file size is large)  
* Add basic (debug) outfit/costume changing
